reevaluation: The finding stands but its scope has shrunk by one page, and the review's fixedAfter: no is now only half true. PR #3135 merged this morning into v2.17.0 and removed the fabricated pagination wrapper from documents.mdx, the file the review named as rootCause, replacing it with the real flat counters in both the response example and the paging loop. The second bound page, first-api-call.mdx, is untouched and still publishes "pagination": { page, perPage, totalPages, totalItems } at L81-L86, as do templates.mdx, teams.mdx and common-workflows.mdx, and I confirmed that live on docs.documenso.com today. So the scenario would still fail if it were bound to the getting-started page, and a developer reading Example 1 there still gets a TypeError. The product side is entirely unchanged and remains correct against its own schema, so this is still a pure doc bug with a docs-only fix. The three remaining corrective PRs are all still open and #3137 is now 'dirty' and needs a rebase after its base moved.
notes: The filer must not describe this finding as 'documents.mdx is wrong' any more; that half shipped in v2.17.0. What remains is first-api-call.mdx (#3137), templates.mdx and teams.mdx (#3138) and common-workflows.mdx (#3139). #3137 is the right place to comment because it carries the remaining bound page, but note that it now has a dirty merge state and no maintainer has ever reviewed it, so the comment should say plainly that its base merged and it needs rebasing onto main. If the maintainers would rather have an issue tracking the four leftover pages as one item, that is a reasonable fallback; the rename map to state is page -> currentPage, totalItems -> count, with perPage and totalPages keeping their names and only losing the nesting level.
